jobs.title: Product Manager - RJ Trust
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Provide timely and quality focused business analysis and assist business stakeholders and Project Managers to ensure success of project delivery. Identify improvement initiatives and solutions and manage their implementation within the business. Understand business needs and opportunities, including a good understanding of business risk and ability to perform and communicate feasibility studies. Manage work estimation and planning of analytical activities which may include team resourcing, project timeframes and scope of projects. Develop and execute plans delegated by managers through reporting and status updates. Create business cases for new or existing ventures the business is considering. Provide risk assessment and general information about impact on the business.

Job Description
Analyze and evaluate the feasibility and relevance of proposed complex financial products, and develop and amend as necessary with guidance from senior colleagues. May also be responsible for supervising activities performed by a financial product development or specialist team. Evaluate the feasibility/relevance of proposed solutions, working in cross-functional or agile teams to develop and deliver significant aspects of the development program. Oversee an operational area with guidance from senior colleagues. Could involve responsibility for development or delivery (or both). Take responsibility for all aspects of a life cycle of a product or set of products, including long- and short-term development and marketing. Stay abreast of trends in the marketplace to ensure the product's competitive position. Develop data-driven analyses to surface new opportunities to differentiate and improve products and user experiences, ensuring consistency across digital products, services, and channels. Skills Manage and develop all aspects of a product or service to ensure it achieves its full impact and value in the market. Determine and analyze trends from data that is collected to assist in compiling reports that will help in decision-making. Analyze and research client and market conditions and facts in order to develop a full and comprehensive understanding of the client and its market to enable maximum returns. Plan, organize, prioritize and oversee activities to efficiently meet objectives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
- Work with functional areas within the department to understand the business case and primary objectives of new projects.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment on initiatives and projects.
- Ability to be involved in numerous projects simultaneously and understand how to prioritize alongside supporting operational functions.
- Reviews operational procedures and methods; maps current business processes; defines and analyzes business activities; identifies best practices; and recommends improvements.
- Consults with users to identify, analyze, refine, and document business requirements.
- Perform gap analysis and translate findings into business process and/or system requirements;
- Support quality assurance reviews of operational processes and oversight.
- Gather data to better forecast and optimize utilization of staff. Develop and define metrics (i.e. productivity, quality, staffing) for department targets.
- Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge of

- Functional, operational, and technical requirements of assigned project(s)/business unit initiatives.
- Back-office concepts, practices and procedures used in the securities industry.
- General financial industry knowledge and knowledge of supported business area.
- Concepts, practices, and procedures analyzing business processes. Business analytics and process improvement.
- Hyland OnBase enterprise content management capabilities, including document management, workflow, imaging, records retention, and system integrations supporting business processes.

Skill in
·         Verbal and written communication;
- Analytics and problem solving; and decision making.
- Preparing various reports, summaries, surveys, and written recommendations.
- Developing and maintaining project plans.
- Business Analysis tools: Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).

Ability to
- Work cross-functionally within an organization to accomplish objectives;
- Maintain a strong attention to detail;
- Communicate effectively with a broad range of audiences;
- Quickly learn new concepts, systems, and processes;
- Translate business needs into requirements for Hyland OnBase configuration, workflow, testing, and enhancement initiatives;
- Establish priorities and meet project time and quality targets; and
- Work independently and with minimal supervision.
- Establish and maintain effective working relationships with others.
- Ask pointed questions to verify clear understanding of client issues.
- Analyze a business function and derive a set of requirements to satisfy a general request.
- Take ownership of an aspect or task on a project with little to no assistance.

***While St. Petersburg, FL is the preferred location for this position, we will consider highly qualified remote candidates with the right experience and demonstrated ability to succeed in the role.***

Education
Bachelor’s: Accounting, Bachelor’s: Business Administration, Bachelor’s: Data Processing

Work Experience
General Experience - 3 to 6 years

Certifications

Travel
Less than 25%

Workstyle
Hybrid

The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave.  Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. To view more details of the benefits offered, visit Myrjbenefits.com.

jobs.title: Senior Mortgage Product Manager (Encompass)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Under limited supervision, uses extensive knowledge and skills obtained through education and experience to identify and implement opportunities for assigned products including product enhancements, and process improvements with potential for improved client/advisor service, increased operational quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Serves as a subject matter expert on mortgage banking origination, pricing, technology, operations, and general business practices. Operates as a senior individual contributor responsible for product development, implementation, and ongoing product management. Leads complex cross-functional projects and initiatives with significant scope and impact through influence, subject matter expertise, and stakeholder alignment. Works on assignments that are broad and complex in nature requiring originality, judgment, and ingenuity with latitude for unreviewed actions or decisions. Works closely with Mortgage Banking leadership to translate business strategy and priorities into product plans, priorities, and execution roadmaps, ensuring product enhancements address key opportunities and deficiencies. Partners with business development teams to create strategies for product positioning and education. End results are evaluated for achieving goals and objectives.

Job Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
- Analyzes market, client, advisor, operational, and business needs to define line of business product strategy, product offerings, product positioning, and short- and long-term product plans.
- Serves as a general subject matter expert on Mortgage banking origination, pricing, operations, and general business practices.
- Collaborates with project teams to represent the product
- Leads cross-functional implementation and execution of technology, new products, product enhancements, and process improvements; establishes clear objectives, dependencies, timelines, decision points, and expected outcomes.
- Leads updates to procedures, policies, and governance documentation.
- Coordinates and governs forms, application, and legal agreement enhancements.
- Serves as liaison between Private Client Banking Training and Sales Support on training for new technology, product, and process enhancements.
- Leads on-field communication with Sales Support to support product enhancements and launches.
- Takes responsibility for all aspects of the life cycle of assigned products, including product development, implementation, positioning, distribution, servicing, ongoing maintenance, and performance, to ensure seamless delivery and alignment with business strategy.
- Collaborates with IT and other partners on the assessment, business requirements, testing, and implementation of IT systems and software that support business strategy, process improvements, broker- dealer integration and risk management.
- Stays abreast of market, industry, regulatory, client, and competitive trends; independently evaluates product performance and identifies opportunities to improve products and business processes based on data and feedback from the field.
- Probes and evaluates complex product, organizational, process, and systems issues; develops reports of findings, alternatives, recommendations, and business cases to support product and project decisions.
- Develops business cases and success metrics for product enhancements and strategic initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes.
- Identifies and manages product-related risks, dependencies, regulatory considerations, and implementation constraints.
- Provides regular reporting and recommendations to Mortgage Banking leadership regarding product performance, roadmap priorities, and strategic opportunities.
- Evaluates and develops business cases supporting product and process improvements.
- Develops and maintains relationships across business units, inclusive of PCG, and communicates product strategies, decisions, and implementation actions in a clear and tailored manner to support the strategic direction of mortgage banking and the broader organization.
- Leads resolution of complex advisor and client issues related to mortgage products.
- Maintains currency on mortgage banking industry changes, trends, process improvement techniques, methodologies and practices.
- Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Knowledge of
- Principles, practices, concepts and procedures of mortgage banking and lending, credit, banking and financial markets and products.
- Product management to include product development, implementation, automation, and ongoing maintenance.
- Established organizational policies, strategies and procedures for RJB Mortgage banking and lending.

Skill in
- Data Analysis.
- Critical thinking, problem solving, creativity.
- Organizational skills, including a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Effective oral and written communications sufficient to convey details on mortgage banking product and processes with all organizational levels
- Word processing, spreadsheet and typing sufficient to produce spreadsheets with basic formulas and business form letters and memos.
- Promoting effective coordination between multiple work groups and functional areas.
- Operating standard office equipment and using required software applications.

Ability to
- Lead complex product development, implementation, and life-cycle management efforts and translate business strategy into clear product priorities, objectives, roadmaps, and execution plans.

- Balance conflicting resource, project, and priority demands; establish clear deliverables, ownership, timelines, and escalation paths across cross-functional initiatives.

- Organize, manage and track multiple detailed tasks and assignments with frequently changing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced work environment with frequent interruptions.

- Identify and recommend changes as appropriate to policies and procedures.

- Work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

- Identify required tasks, develop timelines and execute.

- Partner with other functional areas to accomplish objectives and orient product decisions around the key needs of clients and advisors.

- Facilitate meetings, ensuring that all viewpoints, ideas and problems are addressed.

- Speak clearly and concisely and convey information clearly and effectively through oral or written communications.

Education

Bachelor’s: Business Administration, Bachelor’s: Finance, Bachelor’s: Management Information Systems

Work Experience

General Experience - 6 to 10 years, Manager Experience - 3 to 6 years

Certifications

Travel
Less than 25%

Workstyle
Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager | Electronic Trading Technology
jobs.location: New York, New York - United States
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Note: This position will follow our hybrid work model, we expect the selected candidate to be in the office 3 days a week at the New York City (Park Ave) Corporate Office location.

This role is not eligible for Work Visa sponsorship, either currently or in the future.

Job Description

Working within the Institutional Trading Technology Product Team, the Senior Product Manager serves as the primary technology product partner for assigned Global Equities trading desks, platforms, and capabilities. The role partners directly with Institutional Trading, Engineering, Trading Operations, Compliance/Supervision, Risk, vendors, and other stakeholders to translate business strategy, trading needs, regulatory requirements, and operational priorities into executable product roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

The Senior Product Manager owns the end-to-end product lifecycle, including product strategy, roadmap development, platform modernization, requirements and backlog prioritization, delivery and release planning, client enablement, production support, and ongoing enhancement. The role evaluates opportunities, risks, tradeoffs, dependencies, and investment choices to ensure resources are directed toward the highest-value business outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong institutional equities and electronic trading expertise, sound product judgment, and the ability to independently build credibility with senior stakeholders, influence priorities, and communicate complex issues clearly. The Senior Product Manager must operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly visible environment where technology performance, operational stability, risk controls, and regulatory compliance directly affect trading activity and client service.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
- Serve as the primary technology product partner for assigned Global Equities trading desks, platforms, and capabilities.

- Own the product lifecycle for assigned products, including product strategy, roadmap development, platform modernization, requirements and backlog prioritization, delivery, release, client enablement, production support, and ongoing enhancement.

- Partner directly with trading stakeholders to understand business priorities, client needs, workflows, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear product priorities and executable technology outcomes.

- Own and prioritize product backlogs and investment recommendations based on business value, client impact, risk, cost, dependencies, capacity, and strategic alignment.

- Lead requirements definition and ensure business needs, expected outcomes, controls, and acceptance criteria are sufficiently understood by Engineering and other delivery partners.

- Lead cross-functional delivery across Trading, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance/Supervision, vendors, and other stakeholders.

- Identify and communicate tradeoffs, dependencies, risks, and decisions required to move product initiatives forward. Make clear recommendations when resources, requirements, or stakeholder priorities conflict.

- Provide product leadership during significant production incidents and operational escalations by assessing business impact, coordinating stakeholders, establishing priorities, communicating status, and supporting resolution and follow-up efforts.

- Lead the evaluation, modernization, migration, and strategic replacement of trading platforms and related technology capabilities when existing solutions no longer meet business, client, control, resiliency, or technology needs.

- Support client enablement and business-growth opportunities that require changes to electronic trading capabilities, workflows, integrations, connectivity, or reporting.

- Partner with Compliance/Supervision and Risk to ensure product changes incorporate applicable controls, regulatory requirements, and appropriate governance throughout the product lifecycle.

- Lead engagement with strategic technology vendors, execution venues, market-data providers, and third-party platform providers to drive delivery, issue resolution, product enhancements, service performance, and long-term platform strategy.

- Establish success measures and use operational metrics, trading data, user feedback, incident trends, and business outcomes to evaluate product performance and inform prioritization and investment decisions.

- Monitor developments in electronic trading, market structure, technology, regulation, client needs, and the industry to identify emerging risks, opportunities, and product needs.

- Communicate product strategy, priorities, delivery status, risks, outcomes, and decisions clearly to business and technology stakeholders, including senior management.

- Contribute to interviewing, onboarding, and development of Product Team members as needed.

- Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Knowledge of:
- Sell-side institutional equities, electronic trading workflows, market structure, and trading technology.

- Electronic order lifecycle, routing, execution, market data, reference data, and related front-to-back trading workflows.

- Product management and product development lifecycles.

- Agile software development and backlog management practices.

- Application management and production technology environments.

- Financial-services risk, control, and regulatory considerations applicable to electronic trading environments.

- Third-party trading technology, market-data, and vendor management considerations.

Skill in:
- Developing trusted partnerships with senior trading and technology stakeholders.

- Translating complex business and trading needs into clear product requirements, priorities, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

- Managing competing stakeholder priorities and influencing decisions without relying on formal authority.

- Communicating recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and complex technology issues clearly and concisely.

- Leading cross-functional product delivery across business, technology, operations, control functions, and external vendors.

- Analyzing complex workflows and identifying opportunities for automation, simplification, resiliency, and improved client or trading outcomes.

- Managing change in complex, business-critical technology environments.

Ability to:
- Independently own a portfolio of electronic trading products and initiatives.

- Establish credibility with traders and senior stakeholders through strong domain knowledge, preparation, responsiveness, and sound judgment.

- Challenge assumptions and stakeholder requests constructively while maintaining effective working relationships.

- Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex organizational dependencies.

- Translate strategic objectives into executable product plans and drive those plans through delivery, release, adoption, and outcome measurement.

- Make and communicate recommendations when resources, requirements, or stakeholder priorities conflict.

- Respond effectively to changing trading-desk and production needs while maintaining appropriate focus on committed strategic work.

- Communicate product vision, execution plans, risks, decisions, and status to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Operate effectively in a fast-paced, business-critical electronic trading environment.

Educational/Previous Experience Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Technology, or a related discipline and a minimum of seven (7) years of product management, product ownership, or related experience within financial services, including demonstrated experience in institutional equities, electronic trading, capital markets, or trading technology.

- Demonstrated experience independently partnering with trading stakeholders and cross-functional technology, Operations, Risk, and/or Compliance teams.

- Experience owning technology products through the full product lifecycle, including roadmap development, requirements and backlog prioritization, delivery, release, and ongoing enhancement.

- Experience with electronic trading platforms, order management/execution management systems, market data, routing, or related trading technology is strongly preferred.

- Experience supporting platform modernization, migration, vendor evaluation, or strategic technology replacement initiatives is preferred.

- Experience using product, operational, incident, client, or trading data to inform priorities and evaluate outcomes is preferred.

Licenses/Certifications:
- None required.

Education
Bachelor’s: Business Administration, Bachelor’s: Computer and Information Science, High School (HS) (Required)

Work Experience
General Experience - 6 to 10 years

Certifications

Salary Range
$100,000.00-$175,000.00

Travel
Less than 25%

Hybrid

This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave.  Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. jobs.title: Analyst, Digital Workplace Product Management (Microsoft 365)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Note: This position will follow our hybrid work model, we expect the selected candidate to be in office 3 days per week at one of the following office locations: St, Petersburg, FL or Memphis, TN.

This role is not eligible for Work Visa sponsorship, either currently or in the future.

Job Description

As part of our Digital Workplace Product Management Team, you will play a crucial role in the collaboration between our internal Customers and Engineering Teams, along with our Communications Teams. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing the lifecycle of Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Copilot, Power Platform, and more. You will work with various stakeholders, including technology teams, business analysts and end users to deliver solutions that meet user needs and drive product success. The ideal candidate will have administration as well as product management experience with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem and have excellent written, communication and presentation skills. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic and creative team environment.

Responsibilities:
- Collect and analyze information, interview subject matter experts (SME), and use knowledge of business systems and processes to create detailed product requirements.

- Define product scope and objectives through research and data gathering using a demonstrated understanding of operations, systems and industry requirements.

- Analyze user feedback and determine opportunities for future phases of product lifecycle.

- Create and maintain product roadmaps and feature backlogs.

- Develop and deliver project business/benefits cases.

- Serve as a liaison between client business units and technical business units by analyzing business and user needs; defining requirements; and representing the user in the design, development, validation and implementation of appropriate technology solutions.

- Monitor and report on existing projects, timelines and delivery plans.

- Propose potential solutions to resolve current user pain points and identify areas of opportunity.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including customers, engineering, operations and marketing to deliver high-quality products.

- Assist in planning and implementing change initiatives.

- Serve as a functional SME, providing internal consulting services to assigned functional area(s); coordinate activities with other functional areas.

- Prepare and deliver written and oral presentations to stakeholders.

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities.

- Monitor and report on product performance, making data-driven decisions to optimize and improve.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers to understand their needs and feedback.

- Gather and prioritize product and customer requirements to ensure alignment with business goals.

- Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch, including post-launch performance analysis and iteration.

- Engage with business both proactively and reactively to listen and obtain feedback on the product.

- Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Skills/Previous Experience:
- Ideally three (3) to five (5) years of experience in the administration and product management of Microsoft 365 services focusing on messaging, collaboration, workflow and content management and AI services is preferred.

- Raymond James knowledge and/or financial services industry experience preferred.

- Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Power Platform.

- Deep understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

- Experience in information technology support and technical documentation.

- Strong skills in interpreting client input, clarifying issues and developing solutions.

- Knowledge of user acceptance testing principle, with the ability to develop test plans and scripts.

- Understanding of project management methodologies and the software development lifecycle.

- Familiarity with cloud technologies and integrations.

- Experience in change management and enablement support.

- Strong collaboration, workflow and content management knowledge particularly, OneDrive, SharePoint, Box and Power Platform.

- Strong messaging knowledge – Exchange/Outlook, Teams.

- Ability to act as a liaison between product owners and technology implementers – describe business functions to technical audience and translate technical capabilities, issues to business.

- None required.

Bachelor’s: Computer and Information Science, Bachelor’s: Computer Engineering, Bachelor’s: Computer Systems Analysis, High School (HS) (Required)
